stages.name: Meta signal families
stages.description: Cross-signal breadth and per-family screens from the 47 built-in meta checks.

stages.name: Market and factor context
stages.description: Sector, breadth, volatility, sentiment, commodity, FX, and futures context.

stages.name: Catalysts and open research
stages.description: Upcoming Yahoo earnings catalysts and latest Yahoo news per ticker.

stages.name: Screen history tracking
stages.description: Optional post-screen return tracking; excluded from the default all run.

screeners.name: Fundamental Rotation Screen
screeners.description: Ranks curated companies by Yahoo revenue growth, margin trend, and valuation; leaves unsupported currency ratios blank.
reads: Yahoo Finance statements per ticker; built-in symbol list as selection input only

screeners.name: Revenue Growth Momentum
screeners.description: Compares each company's own annual and quarterly Yahoo revenue-growth direction; cross-company comparisons are directional because fiscal calendars differ.
reads: Yahoo Finance statements per ticker; built-in symbol list as selection input only

screeners.name: Meta Screen: Momentum
screeners.description: Runs the 4 momentum checks across the curated universe; ranks family breadth separately.
reads: Yahoo Finance history/info/earnings/financials per ticker via yahoo_client; built-in demo universe or optional --universe CSV as selection input only

screeners.name: Meta Screen: Technicals
screeners.description: Runs the 4 technical-structure checks across the curated universe; ranks family breadth separately.
reads: Yahoo Finance history/info/earnings/financials per ticker via yahoo_client; built-in demo universe or optional --universe CSV as selection input only

screeners.name: Meta Screen: Valuation
screeners.description: Runs the 5 valuation checks across the curated universe; ranks family breadth separately.
reads: Yahoo Finance history/info/earnings/financials per ticker via yahoo_client; built-in demo universe or optional --universe CSV as selection input only

screeners.name: Meta Screen: Fundamentals
screeners.description: Runs the 3 fundamental-growth checks across the curated universe; ranks family breadth separately.
reads: Yahoo Finance history/info/earnings/financials per ticker via yahoo_client; built-in demo universe or optional --universe CSV as selection input only

screeners.name: Meta Screen: Theme Rotation
screeners.description: Runs the 23 theme-rotation checks across the curated universe; ranks family breadth separately.
reads: Yahoo Finance history/info/earnings/financials per ticker via yahoo_client; built-in demo universe or optional --universe CSV as selection input only
args: theme: AI grid & cooling rotation in

screeners.name: Meta Screen: Insider
screeners.description: Runs the insider cluster-buy check across the curated universe.
reads: Yahoo Finance history/info/earnings/financials per ticker via yahoo_client; built-in demo universe or optional --universe CSV as selection input only

screeners.name: Meta Screen: Earnings Drift
screeners.description: Runs the earnings-beat-drift check across the curated universe.
reads: Yahoo Finance history/info/earnings/financials per ticker via yahoo_client; built-in demo universe or optional --universe CSV as selection input only

screeners.name: Meta Screen: Quality
screeners.description: Runs the 6 business-quality checks across the curated universe; ranks family breadth separately.
reads: Yahoo Finance history/info/earnings/financials per ticker via yahoo_client; built-in demo universe or optional --universe CSV as selection input only

screeners.name: Sector Rotation
screeners.description: Compares sector ETF performance over short and medium horizons.
reads: Sector ETF prices

screeners.name: Market Breadth and Theme Rotation
screeners.description: Measures shares above a long moving average, positive 3-month returns, and median group returns from Yahoo daily closes.
reads: Yahoo Finance daily closes per ticker via yahoo_client; built-in symbol list as selection input only

screeners.name: Volatility Regime
screeners.description: Summarizes VIX levels and term-structure/regime inputs from available market series.
reads: VIX and SPY price histories

screeners.name: Market Sentiment Context
screeners.description: Reports VIX and QQQ/SPY market proxies used by the local sentiment summary.
reads: VIX, QQQ, and SPY price histories

screeners.name: Commodities and FX Context
screeners.description: Summarizes commodity futures and major FX proxies.
reads: Commodity futures and currency-symbol histories

screeners.name: Futures Positioning Proxy
screeners.description: Uses futures price/volume proxies; it is not an official CFTC Commitments of Traders data pull.
reads: Major futures contract histories

screeners.name: Analyst Consensus Snapshot
screeners.description: Collects recommendation, price-target range, and analyst-count fields from Yahoo info for an explicit ticker list or the shared built-in universe.
reads: Yahoo Finance info per ticker via yahoo_client; explicit --tickers or built-in symbol list as selection input only
writes: reports/<date> Analyst Consensus.md (local run-record note; SCREEN_NOTES_DIR overrides)

screeners.name: Portfolio Short-Interest Screen
screeners.description: Fetches Yahoo short-interest fields for an explicit ticker list or the shared built-in universe.
reads: Yahoo Finance info per ticker via yahoo_client; explicit --tickers or built-in symbol list as selection input only
writes: reports/<date> Short-Interest.md (local run-record note; SCREEN_NOTES_DIR overrides)

screeners.name: Portfolio Dividend Screen
screeners.description: Summarizes Yahoo dividend yield and payout fields for an explicit ticker list or the shared built-in universe.
reads: Yahoo Finance info per ticker via yahoo_client; explicit --tickers or built-in symbol list as selection input only
writes: reports/<date> Dividend-Analysis.md (local run-record note; SCREEN_NOTES_DIR overrides)

screeners.name: Portfolio Options-Activity Screen
screeners.description: Checks Yahoo options-chain activity for an explicit ticker list or the shared built-in universe; provider coverage may be incomplete.
reads: Yahoo Finance options/option_chain per ticker via yahoo_client; explicit --tickers or built-in symbol list as selection input only
writes: reports/<date> Unusual-Options.md (local run-record note; SCREEN_NOTES_DIR overrides)

screeners.name: Smart Money Tracker
screeners.description: Ranks institutional ownership share from Yahoo holder tables; blanks when Yahoo has no holder data.
reads: Yahoo Finance per-ticker data via yahoo_client; built-in symbol list as selection input only

screeners.name: Insider Activity
screeners.description: Counts insider buyers vs sellers from Yahoo transactions; cluster buys rank first, blanks on no data.
reads: Yahoo Finance per-ticker data via yahoo_client; built-in symbol list as selection input only

screeners.name: Altman-Z Safety
screeners.description: Ranks Altman Z-scores from Yahoo statements; safe/grey/distress zones, blanks on missing inputs.
reads: Yahoo Finance per-ticker data via yahoo_client; built-in symbol list as selection input only

screeners.name: Cash Return
screeners.description: Ranks FCF yield with buyback yield from Yahoo cashflow; blanks when cashflow or market cap is missing.
reads: Yahoo Finance per-ticker data via yahoo_client; built-in symbol list as selection input only

screeners.name: Dividend Growth
screeners.description: Ranks consecutive annual payout increases from Yahoo dividend history; blanks on no history.
reads: Yahoo Finance per-ticker data via yahoo_client; built-in symbol list as selection input only

screeners.name: Company Catalyst Calendar
screeners.description: Lists only Yahoo earnings dates per ticker for an explicit ticker list or the shared built-in universe; no local calendar fallback.
reads: Yahoo Finance earnings dates per ticker via yahoo_client; explicit --tickers or built-in symbol list as selection input only
writes: reports/<date> Catalysts.md (local run-record note; SCREEN_NOTES_DIR overrides)

screeners.name: Open Research Questions
screeners.description: Lists latest Yahoo news stories per ticker in recency order; not ranked by importance.
reads: Yahoo Finance news per ticker via yahoo_client; explicit --tickers or built-in symbol list as selection input only
writes: reports/<date> Frontier.md (local run-record note; SCREEN_NOTES_DIR overrides)

screeners.name: Meta-Screen Outcome Tracker
screeners.description: Tracks returns after prior meta-screen flags using Yahoo price histories; this is an outcome tracker, not a candidate screener.
reads: Prior Meta-Screen run notes (screen outputs); Yahoo Finance price histories via yahoo_client
